name: Nerva
title: Nerva Caesar Augustus
summary: Nerva was a Roman emperor from AD 96 to 98. Nerva became emperor when aged almost 66, after a lifetime of imperial service under Nero and the succeeding rulers of the Flavian dynasty.
notes: Reign: 1 year, 4 months and 9 days. Nerva's adoption of Trajan set a precedent: emperors would choose capable successors rather than rely on dynastic birth. He also recalled exiles and reformed the treasury. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nerva
